sub_sector.value: Plumbing and HVAC distribution; waterworks and industrial PVF; appliances and lighting

logistics_role.detail: Supplies plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, waterworks, industrial pipe, valves and fittings, and fire products to trade customers, plus appliances and lighting.

asset_intensity.detail: Operates distribution centers and branches for product availability, branch replenishment and final mile distribution.

value_added.detail: Provides fabrication, specialist sales and showroom consulting, and single-source supply chain support for complex capital projects.

notes: The evidence leaves ownership of the facilities and delivery fleet unclear.
